item.title: Ollama Commands and Settings: Model Management, Deleting Models, and Environment Variables
item.description:
Version and safety scope

Last reviewed: October 26, 2026

This is a general command reference, not a version-pinned runbook. Check the installed version, current official documentation, and the target account, host, and path before use. Commands that deploy, destroy, delete, prune, sync, upgrade, or change system settings can cause cost, downtime, or data loss; preview changes and back up where appropriate.

Commands, flags, environment variables, and default paths on this page were checked against the official documentation and source code as of Ollama v0.40.11 (released October 24, 2026): CLI Reference, FAQ, Context length, and API. Defaults can change between versions, so trust the output of ollama -v and ollama serve --help on your machine.
